tr.title: Burası haritada yok
tr.text: Her kıtaya baktık, okyanusların altına bile. Bu sayfa yok ama seni bekleyen 195 ülke var.

en.title: This place isn't on the map
en.text: We searched every continent and even peeked under the oceans. This page doesn't exist, but 195 countries do, and they're waiting for you.
